references.text: The same command to purge evil from the midst of Israel by executing those who lead the people into idolatry
Death penalty for prophets who speak in the name of other gods or presumptuously in the Lord's name
The command to purge evil from Israel is repeated in connection with judgment and disobedience
The same formulation about purging evil from the midst of the people
The same formulation about purging evil from Israel
The warning against listening to false prophets and dreamers who lead people away from the Lord
The Lord condemns prophets who prophesy lies and mislead the people
The reference to the Lord who brought Israel out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery
The reminder that the Lord brought the people out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery
Ezekiel's condemnation of false prophets who lead the people astray
Warning against false prophets who introduce false doctrine among the people
Paul quotes the formulation about driving out the evil one from the church
